sample.description: input array of shape ``(N, D)`` representing ``N`` points in ``D`` dimensions.

bins.description: Specify the number of bins in each dimension of the histogram. (default: 10). May also be a length-D sequence of integers or arrays of bin edges.

range.description: Length-D sequence of pairs specifying the range for each dimension. If not specified, the range is inferred from the data.

weights.description: An optional shape ``(N,)`` array specifying the weights of the data points. Should be the same shape as ``sample``. If not specified, each data point is weighted equally.

density.description: If True, return the normalized histogram in units of counts per unit volume. If False (default) return the (weighted) counts per bin.

output.description: A tuple of arrays ``(histogram, bin_edges)``, where ``histogram`` contains the aggregated data, and ``bin_edges`` specifies the boundaries of the bins.
